component.name: RungStar
component.summary: Karaoke for your own song library

description.p: A karaoke game for UltraStar song files. Point it at a folder of songs and it indexes them in seconds, including their lyrics, so you can find a song by a line you remember rather than by its title.

Up to six people can sing at once across several microphones, with duets, party modes, tournament brackets and fourteen challenge modes. Songs can be browsed and downloaded from USDB without leaving the game, and a built-in editor fixes the timing of a file that is not quite right.
Everything is operable from a controller, at any resolution, so it works on a handheld as well as on a television.
